description: Part-load + ambient temperature derating + HRSG exhaust temperature effect on heat output

unit.name: Generic 5 MW Gas Turbine CHP with HRSG
unit.source: US EPA CHP Catalog (2017); Kehlhofer et al. (2009), Combined-Cycle Gas & Steam Turbine Power Plants; Walsh & Fletcher (2004), Gas Turbine Performance

P_el_rated_kw.note: ISO-rated electrical output at 15 degC, 101.325 kPa

eta_el_rated.note: Electrical efficiency at full load, ISO conditions

eta_th_rated.note: Thermal (HRSG) efficiency at full load, rated exhaust T

PLR_min.note: Minimum part-load ratio for stable combustion

LHV_gas_mjkg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas

th_plr_a.note: Thermal PLR curve constant (HRSG captures more at part load relative to electrical output)

temp_derate_pct_per_k.note: Power derating above ISO reference (gas turbine air-density effect, ~0.6-0.7%/K)

T_exhaust_rated_k.note: HRSG inlet exhaust gas temperature at full load (525 degC typical)

T_exhaust_partload_offset_k.note: Exhaust temp rise when dropping from PLR=1 to PLR=0 (gas turbines run hotter at part load)

T_stack_min_k.note: Minimum stack temperature (acid dew point, ~150 degC)

hrsg_eff_T_coeff.note: HRSG effectiveness sensitivity to exhaust inlet temperature (higher T_exh = more heat recovered)
